Episode 184. Beyond Fate (16)
King Sword, Divine Weapon 10th Sword
Kingdom Ruling Sword - Open
As soon as the five phases started, the darkness lifted.
People covered their eyes with their hands and turned their heads, and the monster's black body barely left its outline, wrapped in blue light.
Its massive body lost its form, buried in the light. Even the underside of Ram covering the sky was almost white.
The light prevented viewers from opening their eyes casually, and the heat that melted even chaos oppressed them from moving freely.
Each second that passed amplified all these phenomena. The black smoke rising from the burning body of the monster was also disappearing without a trace, hidden in the light.
If there was a 'God of Light,' it seemed to be descending right here and now.
If Jin hadn't unfolded both the guardian brothers technique of Linpa, the king of fighters.
From the moment the Kingdom Ruling Sword started, more than half of the allies would have died or been mortally wounded. The allies recognized that fact and were shocked.
[The sword from the day of the declaration...]
The intuition that Jin, her youngest son, would really realize his words to save everyone.
The monster was enveloped in a sense of its heart from human days, now gone, fluttering in madness.
[Monster, you said attacks on the flesh lost their meaning.]
Jin was conveying Vahn's words spreading inside him to the monster.
[Even the real gods who truly transcended the flesh and existed formlessly were torn by my sword. This body has already killed a god......]
Dare not defile my brother's world, the world we should return to.
The moment Vahn finished his sentence.
The monster's body exploded, causing a storm of mixed energy in the territory of the Kingdom Ruling Sword. Mixed energy was covering Jin's body, glowing purple.
Also, the monster's entire castle was disintegrating into mixed energy.
Not only its body, which had become massive to its limits, but also the castle was disintegrating into mixed energy and corroding all sides.
Even those under the protection of the Kingdom Ruling Sword and the Guardian Brothers were covered in mixed energy.
However, the mixed energy could not penetrate inside them. It was because it lacked power. Even though it had collected so much despair and become a god, the monster couldn't pierce Vahn's sword.
Perhaps the total amount of power itself might be more vast than Vahn's.
What lacked was depth and will.
And the reason to fight and to win.
Kwaaa...!
Right after the monster's self-destruction, the center of the light that filled the sky split.
The black energy began to fall, tearing through the gap as if the sky was descending. It was the main gun of Ram spewing out mixed energy.

The main gun that people faced during the first total offensive is a divine technique that could not be avoided or blocked. It could annihilate a city in a few seconds, as the tremendous power moved as fast as light.
However, now, Ram's main gun had lost its speed.
The lightning of the Kingdom Ruling Sword was forcibly slowing down the speed of the main gun. The main gun was slowly coming down like an object quietly sinking in water.
(Is that warship, indeed, the Witch's?)
'Yes, the Divine Siblings.'
Huh...!
Jin clenched his eyes and gripped Sigmund tighter.
Or rather, Vahn did. Due to the continuously increasing synchronization, Jin and Vahn were truly becoming one, not just in name as the 'Divine Siblings Unison' ultimate technique.
This was the reason why the synchronization kept increasing.
[It's not likely the Witch is operating it directly, but it's annoying.]
Just now, Jin was only conveying Vahn's words to the monster, but not anymore. As the harmony deepened, Jin thought and spoke like Vahn.

Vahn was just realizing this fact and was on guard. He thought that at this rate, Jin's ego might collapse. He was momentarily worried that he might unintentionally take over and corrode the body of Jin brothers.
(Divine siblings.)
But as soon as she had that thought, Jin's voice came from within.
The control of the body had completely passed over to Vahn. Now, Jin's ego was rather positioned deeper within.
'Jin brothers, are you not suffering? It's the first time I've found out that the subject of Divine Siblings Unison can change.'
(Yes, don't worry about me, just fight. I can hear Lingling's voice, and it's very comforting. There won't be any collapse of my ego.)
Of course, Jin had perfectly scrutinized Vahn's thoughts. Even if it wasn't the Divine Siblings Unison, he could have done it.
Vahn smiled.
'Understood.'
Annoying.
The reason Vahn thought so while watching Ram's main gun move slowly was nothing else.
Ram is not yet complete, the monster does not have the power of a witch, and sshe herself has materialized.
An incomplete relic left by the Witch couldn't possibly be pointing its muzzle at her threateningly.
[Impudent...]
King Sword, Divine Weapon 10th Sword
Kingdom Ruling Sword - Battle
The roar of Gaebi subsided, and the second decision of the Divine Siblings began.
The march of the real Divine Siblings was sounding. A solemn determination to annihilate the enemy without a trace was making Sigmund shine brightly.
Then the falling main gun of Ram, which was falling slowly, stopped moving. The descending darkness stopped and shrunk tight.
'Has Ram's main gun... completely stopped? Even though Lin Milkano has lost her authority!'
The monster knew of Lin's betrayal since the construction of the castle. The authority that Lin had over Ram was all revoked before the castle was completed.
The main gun did not work properly when the temporary allied army first came, it was just for fun. It was only intended to drive the youngest and the allied army into the castle for trials.
But not now.
Even the monster was unable to hide its shock at the sight of Ram's main gun stopped.
The monster was sure that there was no more powerful means of destruction than Ram's main gun in this world.
During the first total offensive, even Murakan, which was briefly summoned, showed a burden in directly defending against Ram's main gun.
Even if it were Chiron, it seemed impossible to perfectly cut off Ram's main gun. Every time the main gun fired, the fleet of the temporary alliance disappeared one by one.
Kururu... Guwooo...!
The monster's gaze momentarily reached the sky.
The allies in the lightning of the Kingdom Ruling Sword and the Guardian Brothers also looked up at the sky. What they saw was Ram's bombardment, which was spread out like a curtain while stopped.
But in their ears, looking up at the sky, a sound was heard.
A huge warship floating in the sky.
And from a higher sky... deep and gigantic thunder. The sign of thunder and lightning striking the ground.
[Fall.]
Vahn swung Sigmund lightly.

A scream burst out from the monster again. The physical body of the monster was already scattered with the explosion and turned into a storm-like spirit, so the scream of the soul echoed around like an echo.
Each scattered spirit is the body that makes up the monster. The spirits that formed Ram were also mostly spirits derived from her. That is, Ram is also the body of the monster.
That's why the monster was screaming.
Thousands.
Tens of thousands.
Hundreds of thousands of...
Lightning was striking the warship Ram. The entire hull, close to 10 ri, that gigantic ship that had plunged mankind into despair, was breaking as it was struck by the thunder called by the Divine.
There was no room for even a single bug to move on the ship. The thunder perfectly wrapped the entire wide area and still left, tearing apart the nearby void.
[Kuaaaak...!]

Like a human in pain twisting his body, the storm of spirits continued to twist. Bang, bang, bang, bang, bang, every time the thunder fell, Ram was shaking back and forth, left and right, and breaking apart.
Finally, the Malevolent God was engulfed by a 'sense of crisis.'
An emotion he had never felt once since he became a god.
The intuition that she might lose, the anxiety that everything would soon be over if it continued like this, the fear of annihilation.
'Me, feeling fear...?'
It was impossible.
But it was happening.
'Even the sword is not fully unfolded yet!'
The King's Heavenly Sword consists of three parts in total.
Although Rosa did not know this fact, she instinctively realized it. It was because the divine intuition was showing it. The absurd possibility that this domain of thunder could still be expanded.
"Malevolent God, there exists no object that can hover above me."
Vahn raised his left hand and said.

And when he clenched his fist, the halted main cannon of the spaceship Ram was squashed like paint. The lower part of Ram that was revealed between the scattered firing looked shriveled as if something fierce had clenched it. In fact, Vahn's energy had gripped the lower part of Ram.
Soon, Vahn started to lower his outstretched hand.
She is pulling it down.
Ram was being dragged in as if it were merely a slightly heavy object. Like a king disgracefully pulled down from his throne, it was being dragged helplessly.
Even their allies were engulfed in shock at that sight. No, a strange anxiety had been creeping into the minds of their allies ever since Vahn made his appearance.
'If the 12 Knights can use such power at will every time...'
'The moment his heart goes wrong, it's the end of the world. A power that even overwhelms the Malevolent God!'

Those who were worried about the world's destruction due to the Malevolent God's might just a while ago, were now fearing the power of the godly knight. They were imagining the day when that power would become another Malevolent God.
However, not only the allies, but the comrades were simply touched and thrilled. The comrades were picturing Jin becoming the guardian of this world with that transcendent power.

By now, the spaceship Ram was more than twice as close to the ground as before. The power of Vahn, which was pulling Ram, was becoming more immense with time, and there was no sign of the thunder attacking the top to cease.
The Malevolent God, barely pushing away her fear, was thinking.
If it goes like this, it's just a matter of time before he and Ram are annihilated. He could not end such a long-awaited battle so vainly.
'I have to find it. I have to find it!'
She must find something to overcome this crisis!
The Malevolent God steeled his will and glared at Vahn. Even though he couldn't see a way, he had to find one somehow.
Just as his younger brother always did in such desperate situations.
It was now his turn to accomplish what his younger brother always did.
